description: This file defines classes, enums, and functions related to shader qualifier types, including wrappers for different qualifier kinds (invariant, interpolation, layout, storage, precision, memory), and utilities for handling qualifier sequences in shader compilation.

classes.name: TQualifierWrapperBase
classes.description: Base class for qualifier wrappers, providing interface for type, string representation, and rank.

classes.name: TTypeQualifier
classes.description: Struct representing a set of qualifiers for a shader type.

classes.name: TTypeQualifierBuilder
classes.description: Class for building and validating sequences of qualifiers during parsing.

methods.name: JoinLayoutQualifiers
methods.description: Function to combine two layout qualifiers into a single qualifier.

methods.name: TQualifierWrapperBase::getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the qualifier.

methods.name: TInvariantQualifierWrapper::getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the invariant qualifier.

methods.name: TInterpolationQualifierWrapper::getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the interpolation qualifier.

methods.name: TLayoutQualifierWrapper::getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the layout qualifier.

methods.name: TStorageQualifierWrapper::getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the storage qualifier.

methods.name: TPrecisionQualifierWrapper::getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the precision qualifier.

methods.name: TMemoryQualifierWrapper::getRank
methods.description: Returns the rank of the memory qualifier.

methods.name: TTypeQualifier::TTypeQualifier
methods.description: Constructor initializing all qualifiers and scope.

methods.name: TTypeQualifierBuilder::appendQualifier
methods.description: Adds a qualifier to the sequence.

methods.name: TTypeQualifierBuilder::getParameterTypeQualifier
methods.description: Builds a type qualifier for function parameters.

methods.name: TTypeQualifierBuilder::getVariableTypeQualifier
methods.description: Builds a type qualifier for variables.
